newsitem.title: USA: Citadel names Steven Solomon CEO.
newsitem.headline: Citadel names Steven Solomon CEO.

text.p: Citadel Computer Systems Inc said on Monday that chief operating officer Steven Solomon will succeed George Sharp as president and chief executive officer after the company repurchases shares from two directors.
Also, chief financial officer Richard Travis Jr. will assume responsibilities as chief operating officer, the company said.
The executive changes are part of Citadel's consolidation of its operations to the company's Dallas headquarters, it said.
